$comment: Maximal valid Handoff Mode rules object. Every declared property is exercised, with implicit_accept_timeout_ms at a non-sentinel value.

acceptance._note: 30000 rather than 0 on purpose: 0 is the disable sentinel, so a positive value is what proves the timer bound accepts real timeouts.

commitment._note: the SATISFIED case of the designated_role arm.

x-com.example.gov._note: a top-level vendor-extension key (RFC-MACP-0012 §4; issue #185 S1). Its value is a JSON object the standard schema leaves opaque; this proves the x- arm accepts.
